reviews.shade: COSRX Advanced Snail Radiance Dual Essence 80mL
reviews.text: It feels amazing on my skin, loved incorporating this during my hydration part of my routine. Not too heavy for morning application either
reviews.zh: 搽上皮膚感覺一流，好鍾意將佢加入我護膚程序嘅保濕步驟。早上用都唔會太厚重。

reviews.shade: COSRX Advanced Snail Radiance Dual Essence 80mL
reviews.text: I can’t live without it 😍 I keep repurchasing it every time I run out. It keeps my skin hydrated, smooth, and glowing. One of my must-have products! Highly recommend 👍
reviews.zh: 冇咗佢我唔得 😍 每次用晒都會即刻回購。令到我嘅皮膚保持水潤、柔軟又有光澤。係我嘅必備產品之一！強烈推薦 👍

reviews.shade: COSRX Advanced Snail Radiance Dual Essence 80mL
reviews.text: I am very disappointed with the COSRX Advanced Snail Radiance Dual Essence. While the formula itself might be okay, the packaging is extremely frustrating. The pump does not dispense the two liquids evenly; one side always comes out more than the other, which completely defeats the purpose of a dual essence. It is such a waste of product and money. I definitely will not be purchasing this again.
reviews.zh: 對 COSRX Advanced Snail Radiance Dual Essence 非常失望。雖然配方本身可能仲可以，但包裝真係令人好煩。個泵頭根本出唔到均勻嘅兩種液體，永遠都係一邊出多過另一邊，完全違背咗 dual essence 嘅設計原意。簡直係嘥晒支嘢同埋金錢。肯定唔會再買。

reviews.shade: COSRX Advanced Snail Radiance Dual Essence 80mL
reviews.text: It has a light gel-like consistency, is not sticky, and does not have a weird smell. I was worried that the two parts might not distribute the products evenly, but there’s no issue at all.
reviews.zh: 質地係輕盈嘅 gel 狀，唔黐亦都冇古怪嘅味道。本來仲擔心兩種成分會出唔均勻，但完全冇問題。

reviews.shade: COSRX Advanced Snail Radiance Dual Essence 80mL
reviews.text: Repurchased because it was so good. Absorbs very well when patted in, zero irritation on my sensitive skin. Works well under my moisturizer to give extra moisture esp during the winter.
reviews.zh: 因為太好用所以回購。拍上皮膚之後吸收得好快，敏感肌完全唔刺激。秋冬用喺面霜底層做額外保濕特別掂。

reviews.shade: COSRX Advanced Snail Radiance Dual Essence 80mL
reviews.text: Probably on my 9th bottle. This essence that does not irritate my super sensitive skin, and at the same time does not give me breakouts. Also good after long sun exposure as it immediately repairs the irritated skin.
reviews.zh: 應該已經係第九支。呢支精華唔會刺激到我超敏感嘅皮膚，亦都唔會令我爆瘡。長時間暴曬之後用仲好即時舒緩受刺激嘅皮膚。

reviews.shade: COSRX Advanced Snail Radiance Dual Essence 80mL
reviews.text: Esta esencia siento que hidrata bastante y te deja una piel bonita, al principio si se me complico para que salieran las 2 aplicaciones juntas, tuve que tirar como 5 apretones para que porfin salieran las 2 juntas pero si se logró, fuera de eso esta muy bien 👍
reviews.zh: 覺得呢支精華保濕度幾高，用完皮膚望落好靚。頭先用嘅時候，兩種液體一齊出嚟好有難度，我要撳成大概 5 下先至成功出齊兩邊，不過最後都做到。除咗呢點之外都幾好 👍

reviews.shade: COSRX Advanced Snail Radiance Dual Essence 80mL
reviews.text:
I was blown away by how quickly this essence absorbed into my skin, leaving it feeling instantly hydrated and refreshed. It's lightweight and non-greasy, making it perfect for layering under moisturizer and makeup. Plus, the ampoule phase adds an extra boost of moisture and radiance, leaving my complexion looking dewy and luminous.

One of the things I love most about this essence is its versatility. Whether you're dealing with dryness, dullness, or signs of aging, COSRX Advanced Snail Radiance Dual Essence has you covered. It's gentle enough for daily use yet effective enough to deliver noticeable results with continued use.

I've noticed a significant improvement in the overall health and appearance of my skin since incorporating this essence into my skincare routine. My complexion looks brighter, smoother, and more radiant, with a noticeable reduction in the appearance of fine lines and wrinkles.
reviews.zh:
呢支精華吸收速度之快真係令我驚艷，用完即刻覺得皮膚好保濕、好清爽。質地輕盈唔油笠，喺保濕霜同化妝品之前疊用一流。再加上安瓶階段提供額外嘅保濕同光澤感，令膚色睇落水潤有光。

我最鍾意呢支精華嘅一點就係佢嘅多功能性。無論你係面對乾燥、暗沉定係老化跡象，COSRX Advanced Snail Radiance Dual Essence 都可以照顧到。佢夠晒溫和可以日日用，但又夠有效，持續使用可以見到明顯效果。

自從將呢支精華加入我嘅護膚程序之後，皮膚嘅整體健康同外觀都有顯著改善。膚色睇落更明亮、更光滑、更有光澤，細紋皺紋都明顯減少咗。

note: 以下評價由 Olive Young 顧客撰寫，OUJI 原文引用、只加中文翻譯，冇改動內容，亦冇刪走負評。只顯示我哋有貨嘅色號，同價錢有關嘅評價唔會收錄（兩邊售價唔同）。
